articles.title: AWS Bedrock Agents go GA with tool-use improvements
articles.excerpt: Bedrock Agents are now generally available, with better structured tool use, memory persistence across sessions and first-class OpenAPI schema support — putting pressure on Azure AI Foundry and Google Vertex.

articles.title: Cisco quietly updates the CCNA 200-301 blueprint
articles.excerpt: A minor revision to the CCNA exam objectives adds more weight on automation and zero-trust networking. Candidates scheduled after July 1 should budget extra time for the new API / controller-based topics.

articles.title: Two years after xz-utils: what the supply-chain community actually changed
articles.excerpt: The anniversary of the xz backdoor brings a retrospective. Debian now signs all maintainer uploads, the Rust ecosystem adopted automated provenance attestations, and GitHub's sigstore integration is on by default for new repos.

articles.title: Azure AZ-104 blueprint refresh: more identity, less classic networking
articles.excerpt: Microsoft rebalances the AZ-104 Administrator exam: identity and governance grow from 15% to 25%, while classic virtual networks drop to 10%. Entra ID features are now a hard requirement.

articles.title: OpenTofu 1.9 ships with dynamic provider functions
articles.excerpt: The Terraform fork gains dynamic function dispatch inside provider blocks, letting module authors compute provider aliases at plan time. Parity with Terraform 1.10 closes further — BSL migration is nearly over.

articles.title: FortiGate SSL-VPN zero-day: patch before the weekend
articles.excerpt: A critical authentication bypass (CVSS 9.8) in FortiGate SSL-VPN is being actively exploited. CISA adds it to the KEV catalog within 24 hours. Patch or disable SSL-VPN until you can upgrade.

articles.title: Kubernetes 1.31 ships — in-place pod resizing graduates to beta
articles.excerpt: The big one this cycle: in-place vertical pod scaling is now on by default. CKAD candidates, update your notes — exam objectives have followed the feature promotion.

articles.title: CompTIA previews Security+ SY0-702 — shipping Q1 2027
articles.excerpt: First look at the next Security+ revision. Heavier GenAI security section, new sub-domain on post-quantum readiness, and the labs finally get auto-graded. SY0-701 stays available until late 2027.
